## Agenda
- Client updates
- Compiler updates
- Spec updates
  - https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78
  - define `initcontainer_size` for EIP-7620
- Testing updates
- Other items
  - discuss EOF version without irregular state change (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78) and 
  - EOF version without TXCREATE (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76 
  this one needs a slight update, tbd soon), after everyone gets on the same page with the proposals
  - discuss initcode mode validation (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/86)
  - discuss RETURNDATA* 0-padding (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/90)
  - Tune `EXTCALL` with value cost: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/94.
  - Increase the call's `MIN_RETAINED_GAS`: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/95.

Please add other agenda items or links to discuss.

comments.body:
EOF Call # 43 summary

Clients
- Besu, EVMONE keeping up with current spec
- Geth's implementation progressing at a good pace, working on bugs relating to subcontainer data length

Compilers
- Solidity has an old shanghi era compiler that is a base for mega work
- Compiler teams want some parts of the spec guaranteed before serious work can progress.  Specifically the container format and the subroutine and jump functions locked in.

Testing
- Test team is bringing over container testing from retesteth 
  - Format is old shanghai fuzzing format, evmone-parse and geth eofdump implement it
- There is a desire to standardize errors for tests, either as strings or as integer numbers
- Client teams expressed willingness to contribute more tests to supplement testing team's work

Specs
- The [EOF mega spec](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/blob/main/spec/eof.md) is considered to be canonical, EIPs will be brought in line to match
- The following PRs were adopted
  - [PR 78](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78) and [PR 76](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76) relating to TXCREATE and create transactions
  - [PR 86](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76) adding validation rules for init mode and run mode validation
- There was no consensus on the following
  - [PR 90](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/90) relating to changing zero padding behavior or RETURNDATACOPY in EOF
    - One sentiment expressed by Ipsolon is to not change opcodes, but introduce new ones.  This impacts EIP-7676
- New PRs that may be adopted next week
  - [PR 94](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/94) to change EXTCALL costs to match CALL
  - [PR 95](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/95) to adjust the min retained gas on a CALL operation
  
Due to May Day in Europe next week's meeting may be moved, with notice coming no later than Monday the 29th.
